spot_panchnama.place: House No. B-142, Sector 23, Dwarka, New Delhi - Living Room (Ground Floor)

location_details.building: Independent two-storey house, front and back entrances
location_details.entry_used_by_accused: Back window (forced entry - window latch broken)

scene_description.victim_position: Lying face-down in living room, head towards dining area, feet towards sofa
scene_description.blood_pool: Approximately 3 feet x 2 feet around victim's head and upper body
scene_description.blood_splatter: Blood splatter on sofa backrest, TV cabinet, and wall adjacent to victim - indicating violent struggle
scene_description.ransacking: Minimal - dining table chair overturned, kitchen knife missing from knife block

evidence_at_scene.description: Victim's blood, collected in EDTA vial
Fresh prints - later matched to accused
Victim's prints plus one partial print of accused
Size 10 chevron pattern - later matched to accused's shoes
Victim's spectacles, frames bent, one lens broken
Cut marks on both palms indicating defensive struggle
One knife missing from set - later identified as murder weapon
Trail of blood drops - likely from accused leaving

categories: Victim's body position with scale (5 frames)

time_of_death_estimation.based_on: Body temperature, rigor mortis, blood coagulations, witness statements
time_of_death_estimation.confirming_evidence: Neighbour's account of scream at 21:45, CCTV of accused entering 21:15 and exiting 22:00

spot_panchnama.panchnama_conclusion: The crime scene examination reveals a violent struggle. Victim was attacked with a sharp-edged weapon (knife) in living room. Multiple stab wounds evident. Blood trail from victim to back window/side gate establishes escape route. Missing kitchen knife from knife block correlates with the murder weapon later recovered. Fresh fingerprints and footwear impressions at entry points establish accused's physical presence. Time of death corresponds with window when accused was present based on CCTV.
